svg.title: Weekly commits to each protocol: official and third-party repositories
svg.desc: Small multiples, one panel per protocol, shared scale, official and third-party lines. MCP 4419 official and 3091 third-party commits; A2A 2289 official and 151 third-party commits; MPP 1114 official and 400 third-party commits; AGNTCY 1368 official commits; Web Bot Auth 96 official and 1062 third-party commits; UCP 711 official and 310 third-party commits; L402 272 official and 200 third-party commits; ERC-8004 115 official and 259 third-party commits; KYA-OS 324 official commits; ACP 100 official and 146 third-party commits; PAP 31 official and 177 third-party commits; AP2 20 official and 128 third-party commits; KYAPay 62 official and 77 third-party commits; ANS 104 official and 14 third-party commits; TAP 1 official and 112 third-party commits; x401 48 official and 4 third-party commits; Verifiable Intent 4 official and 15 third-party commits; no data for Baselayer KYA, Stripe SPT, Amex Intent Intelligence
svg.text: Weekly commits to each protocol: official and third-party repositories
Last 52 weeks to mid-Oct 2026. Same scale in every panel (0 to 360), sorted by total commits.
Each line adds commits across its repositories, which are listed below. Dashed shading means no repository existed yet.
